recipes.title: Separate synchronization from recoverable history
recipes.description: Choose a workflow by what it preserves after deletion or overwrite, not by whether it copies files. Documentation review is not a restore test.

picks.label: Continuous peer synchronization
picks.reason: Keeps selected device folders synchronized; optional per-folder versioning archives changes received from other devices.
picks.tradeoff: Versioning is off by default and does not preserve the prior version of a local edit on that same device.

picks.label: Explicit copy versus mirror transfer
picks.reason: Choose copy when destination-only files must remain, or sync when mirroring is genuinely intended.
picks.tradeoff: Sync may delete destination files; inspect --dry-run before use. A transfer alone does not establish historical recovery.

picks.label: Versioned backup with explicit data placement
picks.reason: Provides encrypted incremental backups; documented portable mode places server data beside the program files.
picks.tradeoff: Keep backup credentials and test restoration and folder relocation; portable-mode documentation is not a full no-outside-writes audit.
